fieldValues.title: Reading views for the shared packages
fieldValues.summary: Almost no type in the programme or muSrs has a reading view, so every record renders as a list of labelled fields with ids and paths among them.
evidence: Audit 2026-10-30 L2: programme 0/44 types, muSrs 2/67 types, spec 2/15 types, handbook 0/5 types
LiveWyer Insight and srs-context pass with one view per type
fieldValues.body: One reading view per type in each shared package: title as heading, prose without labels, machine fields hidden. One package change improves every repository that uses it.
